verdict.rationale: Feitian keys are documented as fully WebAuthn/FIDO2 and U2F compliant with HID/USB/NFC/BLE interfaces, and vendor docs explicitly cover registration flows for Microsoft/Azure AD, GitHub (OpenSSH/GitHub), general online account registration, and Google Advanced Protection integration, implying broad cross-service compatibility. missing for 10: no explicit mention of major password manager integrations (1Password, Bitwarden, etc.) and no independent/hands-on third-party corroboration of real-world compatibility across these services.
